text.text_excerpt: We bought the CUTEST hat here. It has ears and it's furry and I will wear it all the time. But that's neither here nor there. We wandered into this gumbo festival a little late so it was already crowded, lines were long, vendors were running out of stuff. Moral of the story: get there early! However, there was a good variety of food and a decent number of vendors, as well as Trombone Shorty and the Rebirth Brass Band. We hopped on some corn and cheddar shrimp n grits and two types of gumbo. THe seafood gumbo and grits were wildly delicious, full of flavor and hot hot. Then we stood in line for beer like suckers until we realized that this was New Orleans and we could just go buy beer. So,...

What luck my boyfriend and I had to happen to be visiting NOLA during the week of the gumbo festival! When we saw it advertised around the city we knew we had to visit, to further our goal of cramming as much food into our faces as possible during our visit. We kinda thought it would be a flat rate for small samples, but it was free entry and pay as you go. I wish the servings were a little smaller so you could try more, but everything we tried was amazing. It was interesting to sample the different takes on their gumbo and other dishes. There was even one stand shucking and grilling oysters which were delicious. I think my favorite offering came from Tiger's Creole Cuisine. They had a di...

Favorite Creole food: Gumbo. Favorite NOLA music: Brass bands. No way I'm missing this. Early Saturday afternoon we strolled around while the Paulin Brothers played and got some of Miss Linda's gumbo (very good) and yakamein (amazing!). Then we caught the last half of Leah Chase's cooking demonstration, and I quickly wished that she had run for president...what a wise and charming woman! And how on earth she threw together the wonderful elixir she passed out to the crowd in 45 minutes is beyond me! Dooky Chase is on the list for next trip for sure. The bands were all terrific, special shout out to the TBC, who I got to follow at the Sudan second line the next day. Sunday's big guns, Hot 8...
